description: This header defines the recommended Uniform Random Bit Generator (URBG) types for use within the Abseil Random library, including classes like absl::BitGen and absl::InsecureBitGen, along with their associated functions and internal engine types.

classes.name: absl::BitGen
classes.description: A general-purpose random bit generator optimized for generating non-cryptographically secure random values.

classes.name: absl::InsecureBitGen
classes.description: A faster, less random, non-cryptographically secure random bit generator for performance-sensitive use cases.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random value using the bit generator.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the smallest possible value from the generator.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the largest possible value from the generator.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Advances the internal state of the generator by a specified number of steps.
